nom: DUNE SUNCARE The Mug Guard Broad Spectrum SPF 30

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin generally describe it as lightweight and non-greasy with a matte-to-dewy finish, though several of the most critical reviews also come from reviewers who identify as oily or acne-prone and report breakouts and a greasy after-feel.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report it leaves their face dewy and hydrated for hours, though one reviewer with sensitive, dry skin found it drying, with peeling and flaking.
segments.sensitive: Many reviewers with sensitive skin, including some with rosacea, eczema or psoriasis, report no stinging and reduced redness, but one reviewer states it is not great for sensitive skin and caused drying and peeling, and several separately mention mild burning near the eyes.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination or combination/acne-prone skin describe it as lightweight and non-pore-clogging under makeup.

concerns.redness: Reviewers who mention redness or rosacea report the green-tinted formula visibly calms redness and blends it out, with no reviewer in this set reporting new redness from the product itself.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers who identify as acne-prone report no new breakouts and credit the sunscreen for not clogging pores, but three of the lowest-rated reviews describe breakouts, including one acne-prone reviewer who says it broke her out badly across her face within two days.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers dealing with dehydration mostly find the gel hydrating for hours, including layered under a serum, though one reviewer with sensitive, dry skin found it drying, with peeling and flaking.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers managing oiliness describe the gel as absorbing quickly without greasy residue and controlling shine, while a few critical reviews describe it sitting greasy on top of the skin or increasing oil production.

aspects.libelle: Stings or burns eyes on application
Dewy, glowy finish rather than matte

extraits.titre: These reviews are lying to you
extraits.texte: It is not as good as people are saying in the reviews. Yes, it blends out well but it just stays on top of your skin and leaves you with a greasy feeling. Also, for the price… definitely not worth it. I couldnt even finish the whole bottle because it was breaking me out so bad. Some people are saying its good for people with acne prone skin but as someone with acne prone skin, yeah it is not it. I gave it to a relative because i didnt want to be wasteful and even they didnt like it and theyre honestly not that picky with their skincare. Korean sunscreens are the way to go especially if youre acne prone and the prices are a lot more cheaper!
Not great for sensitive skin. I love a milky SPF for layering other products but even with a heavy moisturizer underneath it dried my skin and caused peeling and flaking

I did really like this product at first, it applied nicely and left a glowy finish with no white cast, my makeup applied well over it, However after about two days of use my face broke out EVERYWHERE. I have at least 10 new pimples across my mouth, chin, forehead, eyebrows, and jawline. :( I do have slightly acne prone skin but nothing has ever made me break out so badly all at once. This is the only change I made in my routine and after discontinuing use of the product for a few days my skin has started to calm down so the sunscreen has to be the culprit. Two stars because I would love the product if it were actually viable for use on my skin but as it stands I wasted my money unfortunately.

extraits.titre: ULTA!!! PLEASE, NEVER GET RID OF THIS PRODUCT!!!
extraits.texte: I have been searching for the perfect SPF/moisturizer duo for my very oily and very dehydrated skin. I hate layering a moisturizer AND an SPF, SPF moisturizers are usually too heavy and/or don't sink into my skin, and I hadn't found a good SPF to go under makeup without making the base break apart from the excess oil. THE DAYS OF THESE FRUSTRATIONS ARE OVER! Pairing this with a niacinamide serum underneath has been the answer to all my woes. If you have oily skin that also feels weirdly tight (thank you constant AC and indoor heating), I would bet money that you'd love this too!

I was so pleasantly surprised by this sunscreen. I have extremely sensitive skin, acne, rosacea, eczema, you name it. Finding a sunscreen that doesnt cause a reaction felt impossible but alas sunscreen is a necessity. I took a chance on this when it was on sale because of the glowing reviews truthfully not expecting much other than an overpriced basic sunscreen. I am happy to admit I was wrong. I LOVE this sunscreen. It goes on so well, never breaks my skin out with rashes or acne, and reapplies without becoming a mess. I have started using this on my kids too. I came back to order more and leave this review. The bottle is small but it spreads out very well. 10/10 RECOMMEND if your skin cant tolerate most drug store brands.

I have sensitive, dry skin. I'm newer to using sunscreen daily. I researched many brands and this had great reviews, so I bought it hoping for the best. Using it over my serums has helped them work their magic. My dark spots have eased up and my expression lines are less prominent. My skin is more hydrated and plump. I plan to keep using this because "if it ain't broke, don't fix it" and it works perfectly for me! Also, sometimes when I introduce a new product, my skin has a bad reaction (redness, irritation, breakout) and this sunscreen has not caused any negative reactions.

I got a mini guard and I'm convinced of buying the full size because I have mild rosacea on my cheeks and when applying this, the redness went away, it's lightweight which is perfect for the climate I live.
